interpretation: Cached onset-level research result only. Better five-clip averages coexist with named regressions and a failed minute control. No quality exceptions, clip filtering, parameter rescue or deployment is authorized by this artifact.

definitions.B: Accepted baseline Analysis and actual original Chart12 goldens, loaded from the unchanged prior cache. B analyzer/Chart were not rerun in this screen.
definitions.F: Feature-only atom statistics appended to B. Stripping only unifiedAttackObservations restores the whole B Analysis exactly; all 144 actual F Charts are byte-identical to B goldens. F raw score fields explicitly reference B rather than inventing a new measurement.
definitions.C: Shared physical attacks with one unit mass per atom, consumed by the accepted tempo estimator and beat tracker, then assigned real primary/half/quarter roles. The cached screen made one C application and two actual Chart calls per mode for each of 36 successful B caches.
definitions.head: uniqueHeads(one-finger generated chart); simultaneous chord notes at the exact same time contribute one head. Scores use the saved original matching counts at 50/70 ms.
definitions.clock: Analysis.rhythm.beats; this can differ from the B chart clock when B support is low. Scores use the saved original matching counts at 50/70 ms.
definitions.pulse: uniqueHeads(analysis.pulse?.onsets ?? analysis.onsets). This is the materialized pool, including free physical candidates; it is not the beat clock or only primary-role atoms.
definitions.macro: Unweighted mean over the same five observed clips; n=5 for every one of the 18 macro cells. Five genre proxies are not a ten-genre population.
definitions.modeRows: 36 paired records × four modes = 144 complete mode pairs, under paired[].variants.B/C.modes. Counts, holds, tails, held seconds, 4-second head density, peak fingers, legality, determinism, origin counts, identity and raw scores are stored there once; redundant summary mode tables are omitted.
definitions.fourFinger: Measured four-mode head-count retention is C/B. identity20 is saved matched original-head recall at 20 ms, not a note-count ratio or an independently replayed matcher.
definitions.negativeLists: All strict C < B cells are retained, including tiny floating-point decreases. No tolerance, rounding or quality exemption changes the original gate.
definitions.occupation: Saved lane/note/hold domains and release occupation were rechecked in postflight. A stored route certificate was checked; the fingering planner was not rerun.
definitions.determinism: 144 C mode comparisons each used two actual Chart calls. Only first outputs are captured; second-call accounting and deterministic flags are checked without claiming independent second full captures.
definitions.rejection: The five inherited B rejects have zero F/C application calls and do not establish UA1 analyzer rejection behavior.

primitiveMath.scope: Physical atoms and roles with supplied clocks only; no accepted tracker or music quality test.

Finger occupation/lane/note domains are recomputed; the saved route certificate is checked without rerunning the fingering planner.
Only the first C chart is captured; deterministic=true and actual second-call entry accounting are checked, not an independent second stored output.

findings.role: Saved scalar causal findings; original timing and ID tapes remain private

files.role: Inactive ordinary git patch for the exact C28 source graph
Inactive source provenance manifest with original null numerical binding
Actual ordinary git apply and exact C28 source reconstruction proof

inactiveSourceProof.numericalBindingLocation: This diagnostic.evidence and source file hashes bind the saved result separately. The copied source manifest retains its original null numerical binding; source reproducibility alone is not numerical quality.

originalQualityGate.comparison: Strict original PULSE inequalities, no rounding, epsilon, exemptions or dropping failed C predictions.

causalProjection.scope: Scalar statistics from the saved seven-case identity/group/role/Chart audit. No new reference matching, alternative tracker, original timing or member-ID tapes are included.
conclusions: Minute: all 120 old canonical primary events occupy distinct atoms; none are collapsed together, and their original salience remains in the canonical pool. The new unit-observation clock changes seed 120 to 133 and median grid interval 0.5 s to about 0.45 s. Only 14 old families remain primary; one-finger keeps every one of the 135 new primaries. This supports changed clock/role interpretation rather than lost old observations or downstream deletion of those new primaries.

Disco: all 60 old primary witnesses occupy distinct families; 53 remain primary, five become half, one quarter and one unbound. Ten of 63 new primaries come from other families. Representative displacement and role choice both change; without a new match or counterfactual clock the six lost saved hits cannot be allocated to either factor.

Old B primary is an algorithm label, not ground truth. Small residuals to the new grid do not establish correct musical phase or tempo. No candidate, grouping width, median rule, unit weight, prior or quality threshold changed after the failed result.
